items: Feedback management gets harder with every location, because guest comments scatter across reviews, surveys, support tickets, social media and delivery apps.
Good software covers four jobs: capturing every guest signal as it arrives, replying quickly and personally, recovering unhappy guests before they churn, and acting on recurring patterns.
Use AI analysis to see what drives positive and negative feedback and where incidents happen most, so you fix service or quality issues before they spread across stores.
Momos gathers reviews, surveys, social, email and delivery feedback in one Unified Inbox, and its AI agent Alfie writes an on-brand, personalized reply to each guest.
